A1.justification: Both PDFs describe KANO: Kolmogorov–Arnold Neural Operator and contain readable methods, experiments, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–E. Content can be matched reliably despite introductory restructuring and renumbering.

before.justification: v3 reports original synthetic-operator generalization experiments and double-well/NLSE quantum-dynamics simulations, including losses, state infidelities, and recovered symbolic coefficients in Tables 1–4.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and simulation outcomes in Section 5 and Tables 1–4, with experimental details in Appendix B.

M1.justification: Sections 4 and 5.2 retain the same KAN symbol and activation networks, Kohn–Nirenberg quantization, symbolic recovery procedure, and Q-KANO adaptation. The introductory rewrite does not change the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three synthetic operators, Group A/B function families, interpolation scenarios, and double-well/NLSE dynamics under the same supervision scenarios. New fluid-flow examples in the introduction are motivation, not additional evaluations.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains FNO, U-FNO, AM-FNO, PDNO, and the same KANO variants; Table 3 retains the same FNO/Q-KANO comparisons. Newly discussed methods such as DeepOKAN are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B preserve sample counts, grids, model configurations, losses, and testing procedures, including 100-step interpolation and training on the first 10 quantum time steps before evaluating the remaining 90.

E4.justification: The KANO and Q-KANO MLP ablations, interpolation analysis, supervision comparisons, and symbolic reconstruction analyses are retained unchanged. No additional robustness test or case study appears.

E5.justification: The tables and plots retain the same statistical reporting. Neither the main text nor Appendix B adds seed counts, repeated-training-run information, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and plotted findings match across versions. Examples include KANO's G1 Group B loss of 1.44e-4 in Table 1 and Q-KANO's double-well position-plus-momentum infidelity of 6.3e-6 in Table 3. The new introduction summarizes existing results.

T1.justification: The theoretical statements, proofs, and complexity derivations in Sections 3–4 and Appendices C–E are unchanged. Seven duplicated background equations are consolidated and subsequent equations renumbered; this does not remove mathematical substance.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion are unchanged, but the new introduction explicitly claims the first demonstrated and quantified symbolic recovery via KAN in operator learning and distinguishes KANO from DeepOKAN. The central expressivity, generalization, and performance claims remain intact.

C2.justification: The explanations involving dual-domain sparsity and input-dependent spectral mixing are retained. Qualifications concerning smooth symbols, high-dimensional applications, quantum observability, and computational cost also remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Appendices D–E.

D1.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same implementation settings, data-generation formulas, discretization and integration details, training losses, and storage formats. No additional reproducibility information or code/data access is introduced.

R1.justification: v4 substantially expands research positioning through discussion of scientific machine learning, factorized/multiscale/local FNO variants, KAN system identification, and KAN operator networks. New references include DeepOKAN, KAN-ODEs, EFKAN, and MscaleFNO, alongside explicit distinctions concerning symbolic recovery and generalization.

P1.justification: v3 repeats operator-learning/FNO and KAN background under both Introduction and Background. v4 replaces this duplication with a substantial motivation and related-work introduction, adds a three-part contribution overview, and retains a single background treatment.

P2.justification: The opening pages change from duplicated equation-heavy background to introductory prose and contribution bullets, and the bibliography reflows. Figures 1–6, Tables 1–5, and the appendix training-loss table preserve their designs and content.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects the conspicuous duplication between Introduction and Background and supplies clearer motivation, a contribution overview, and more informative comparisons with prior work. This improves readability and research positioning, while the experiments, proofs, and reproducibility material provide the same substantive support as before.
